tei:div.tei:p: (261)mkha' 'gro'i las byang tshogs mchod rtsar phreng bzhugs so: (262)

rigs kyi ḍāk+ki lnga la phyag 'tshal lo: bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: rigs kyi ma mo mkha' 'gro yi: las byang tshogs mchod rim pa bri: 'di la spyi don bcu bzhi ste: dang po bgegs gtor sbyin nas ni: bka' bsgo mtshams gcod rim pa ni: rang nyid lha yi nga rgyal gyis: hūm̐: nyon cig bgegs dang log 'dren tshogs: lus ngag yid la gnod pa'i bgegs: bar chad 'byung po thams cad kyang : 'di ru ma 'dug gzhan du dengs: hūm̐: nga ni dpal chen rta mgrin rgyal: rdo rje 'jigs byed 'bar ba'i sku: sku gsum nyid kyang 'joms par byed: nga ni bka' las 'das gyur na: thal ba'i rdul bzhin brlag par 'gyur: oṃ shraṃ badz+ra h+ya gh+raṃ wa ra tsa hrī ya ha ri ni sa rak+ṣa u tsa ta ya hūm̐ phaṭa: de nas mtshams bcad pa ni: hūm̐: rab 'jigs phra men khro mo'i sku: badz+ra seng ha seng ge'i gdong : badz+ra bya kri stag gdong (263)ma: mthing nag mtshon cha me 'od 'phro: gti mug dbang bsgyur las mkhan ma: steng 'og dgra bgegs mtshams chod cig: hūm̐: rab 'jigs phra men khro mo'i sku: ka ka mu kha bya ro gdong : dkar gsal mtshon cha me 'dod 'phro: zhe sdang dbang bsgyur las mkhan ma: shar sgo'i dgra bgegs mtshams chod cig: hūm̐: rab 'jigs phra men khro mo'i sku: hu lu mu kha 'ug gdong ma: ljang nag mtshon cha me 'od 'phro: phrag dog dbang bsgyur las mkhan ma: byang sgo'i dgra bgegs mtshams chod cig: hūm̐: rab 'jigs phra men khro mo'i sku: shwa na mu kha khyi gdong ma: dmar nag mtshon cha me 'od 'phro: 'dod chags dbang bsgyur las mkhan ma: nub sgo'i dgra bgegs mtshams chod cig: hūm̐: rab 'jigs phra men khro mo'i sku: su ra ke seng (264)phag gdon ma: ser nag mtshon cha me 'od 'phro: nga rgyal dbang bsgyur las mkhan ma: lho sgo'i dgra bgegs mtshams chod cig ces mtshams bcad/ sum bha ni bzlas so/ de nas spyan drangs ba ni: hūm̐: chos dbyings gsal mdangs klong dkyil nas:

rig 'jig brgyud pa gshegs su gsol: sku dang zhing khams gzhal yas nas: yi dam lha tshogs gshegs su gsol: snang stong thig le'i gzhal yas nas: rta mgrin yab yum gshegs su gsol: rtse mo rnam bkod bde ba'i zhing : sum brgya drug cu'i gzhal yas nas: rdo rje ḍāk+ki yab yum rnams: sum brgya drug cu gshegs su gsol: mgrin pa ro 'dus longs spyod zhing : bcu drug bkod pa'i gzhal yas nas: rin chen ḍāk+ki yab yum rnams: bcu drug ma lus gshegs su gsol: (265)dran pa rnam bkod chos kyi zhing : sum cu rtsa gnyis gzhal yas nas: sangs rgyas ḍāk+ki yab yum rnams: sum cu rtsa gnyis gshegs su gsol: skye byed drug cu sprul pa'i zhing : drug cu'i rtsa bzhi'i gzhal yas nas: pad+ma ḍāk+ki yab yum rnams: drug cu rtsa bzhi gshegs su gsol: myos byed rnam bkod bde ba'i zhing : nyi shu rtsa brgyad gzhal yas nas: las kyi ḍāk+ki yab yum rnams: nyi shu rtsa brgyad gshegs su gsol: rtsa khams rang bzhin gnas pa'i zhing : bkod pa lus kyi gzhal yas nas: dpa' ba mkha' 'gro bye ba stong : ma lus 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol: de dag kun gyi bka' 'khor na: phyogs skyong zhing skyong klu chen rgyad: stong gsum 'jig rten khams dag na: gnas bzhugs rigs bsdus ma srin tshogs: 'khor (266)dang bcas pa gshegs su gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki na ha ni ni sa ra tsa hrīḥya sa ma ya bi shwa lo ka ḍāk+ki sa ma ya jaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ phaiṃ phaiṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā: zhes spyan drangs ngo : de nas bzhugs su gsol ba ni: hūm̐: gnas lnga ye shes lhun grub dkyil 'khor du: thabs shes nyi zla pad+ma'i gnad steng du: bla ma bde gshegs ḍāk+ki'i tshogs rnams bzhugs: sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: de nas phyag 'tshal ba ni: hūm̐: dus gsum bla ma yi dam ḍāk+ki ma: chos nyid rnam dag gtso 'khor bcas pa la: lus ngag yid gsum dgus pas phyag 'tshal lo:

zhes phyag bya'o: de nas mchod pa 'bul ni: dang po phyi yi mchod pa la: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ bla ma bde gshegs ḍāk+ki la: phyi yi mchod pa 'bul ba ni: mjes pa'i me tog spyan la 'bul: dri zhim bdug spos shangs la (267)'bul: snang gsal dmar me spyan la 'bul: yi 'ong chab bsil thugs kar 'bul: zal zas ro mchog ljags la 'bul: rol mo sna tshogs snyan la 'bul: 'gro ba'i don du mchod de bzhes: de nas nang mchod 'bu ba ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ bla ma bde gshegs ḍāk+ki ma: nang gi mchod pa 'bul ba ni: dbang po rnam lnga'i me tog mchod: gsur chen dri yi bdug spos mchod: zhu chen snang gsal mar me mchod: rdo rje dri chus byug pas mchod: bdud rtsi dri chen zhal zas mchod: rkang gling thod rnga dril bus mchod: byang sems dkar dmar bdud rtsis mchod: dug lnga ye shes lnga ru mchod: dug gsum sku sku gsung thugs su mchod: snang srid phyag rgya bzhi ru mchod: 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol: de nas (268) gsang mchod 'bul ba ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la: gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni: yab yum gnyis med mkha' gsang sa: 'khril sbyor byang chub sems kyis mchod: bde ba'i re snyoms mchod par bzhes: sku lus rgyas phyir bzhes su gsol: de kho na nyid kyis mchod pa ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ bla ma bde gshegs ḍāk+ki la: ye shes mchod pa 'bul ba ni: bde gsal rig pa mim rtog snang : snang ba sna tshogs thams cad kun: bde stong gsal steng rig pa stong : mi rtog snang ba rang bzhin stong : ye shes lnga ldan ngang du bzhes: de nas bdud rtsi'i mchod pa ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ bla ma bde gshegs ḍāk+ki la: bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni: rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi amṛ ta: dug lnga gnas bsgyur ye shes bsgrub pa'i rdzas: ro (269)mchon yon tan kun dang ldan pa 'di: gsol lo mchod do 'gro ba'i don la bzhes:

sarba pañtsa amṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi: de nas gtor ma'i mchod pa ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: bla ma bde gshegs ḍāk+ki la: gtor ma'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni: zhal zas sna tshogs gtor chen la: sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga rgyan ldan: dri mchog ro brgya ldan pa yi: ba ling brgyan can gtor ma 'bul: 'gro ba'i don phyir bzhes su gsol: de nas ḍāk+ki'i rim pa bas byung ba'i bstod pa bya ba ni: hūm̐: ma skyes rnam dag chos kyi dbyings nyid las: rkye ba'i rdzu 'phrul 'bar ba' skur ston pa: 'gro don mjad pa'i ye shes mkha' 'gro ma: chags tshul 'gro don sku mdog dkar dmar mor bstan: gcer bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku mnga' ma: dug gsum 'joms mjad phag mo'i skur (270)bstan ma: sna tshogs sprul pas 'gro ba'i don mjad ma/ phyag g.yas gri khug dug lnga gcod cing gtub: phyag g.yon thod khrag skye med dbyings su rol: rtse gsum mchan khung bzung nas dug gsum sgrol: dbu skra gyen thur 'phyang bas sprul pa sna tshogs 'gyed: rus rgyan me long rgyan chas mkha' 'gro dbang du sdud: ye shes me yis mi shes mun pa 'joms: g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang thabs dang shes rab dang : ma rig mun sel nyi zla'i gnad steng du: rnam rtog 'joms pa mi re'i gdan la bzhugs: mthong dang dran pa tsam gyis ye shes skyes: yon tan bye bas brgyan pa'i sku mnga' ma: ye shes ḍāk+ki ma la phyag 'tshal lo: bde gshegs rig kyi ḍāk+ki ni: nam mkha' lta bur 'dus ma byas: skye ba med pa'i sku la bstod: (271)rdo rje rigs kyi ḍāk+ki ni: skye shi med de rdo rje'i sku: 'gyur ba med pa'i sku la bstod: rin chen rigs kyi ḍāk+ki ni: mi zad pa yi gter dang ldan: yid bzhin nor 'dra'i sku la bstod: pad+ma rigs kyi ḍāk+ki ni: chags pa la sogs rkyen dang bral/ dri med ye shes sku la bstod: las kyi rigs kyi ḍāk+ki ni: phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis grub:

bdag gzhan don rdzogs sku la bstod: dam tshig rigs kyi ḍāk+ki ni: ye bsrungs chen po'i ngo bo ste: rkyen med rnam dag sku la bstod: 'jig rten rigs kyi ḍāk+ki ni: chos mjad bstan pa bsrung mjad ma: thog med rdzu 'phrul sku la bstod: thams cad ma lus ḍāk+ki ni: gang mtshams phrin las sgrub mjad ma: phyogs med yon tan sku la bstod: sha za rigs kyi ḍāk+ki ni: mi bsrun drag mo'i (272)cha byad can: dam nyams srog gcod sku la bstod: bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum byin gyis rlobs: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub zhu: rkyen bgegs bar chod bzlog tu gsaul: dgra bgegs ma lus zhi bar mjod: ༈ de nas tshogs kyi mchod pa ni: ye shes mkha' 'gro yab yum kyi tshogs mchod 'di la bcur gnas pa las: dang po phrin gdags pa ni: hoḥ gsan cing dgongs su gsaul: chos dbyings rnam par dag pa'i klong dkyil nas: 'gro ba 'dul ba'i bcom ldan 'das dpal chen rta mgrin yab yum mkha' 'gro 'bum tshogs yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa ma lus gsan cing dgongs su gsol: ces bya'o: de nas gnyis pa tshogs dri ma sbyangs pa ni: tshogs la bsang chu gtor la: swa bha wa 'i sngags brjod: hūm̐: rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'jin gyis: chos rnams sgyu mar rig bya'i phyir: dngos dang dngos 'jin bag chags kun: yi ge raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gsum gyis: bsregs (273)cing bkrus te gtor bar bya: dag par ma gyur gang yang med: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ swā hā: zhes brjod pas dag par bsam mo: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥtri: ye shes rnam lnga'i rang bzhin las: zhal zas dngos po yi ge lnga: yi ge'i sgra dang bcas pa yis: tshogs kyang 'od du ltem gyis zhu: 'od phung 'bar ba'i byin rlabs kyis: rgyal ba'i thugs dam bskang gyur cig: ces byin gyis brlab po: gsum pa yul spyan drangs ba ni: hūm̐: chos dbyings gsal mdangs klong dkyil nas: rig 'jin brgyud pa gshegs su gsol:

sku dang zhi khams gzhal yas nas: yi dam lha tshogs gshegs su gsaul: snang stong thig le'i gzhal yas nas: rta mgrin yab yum gshegs su gsol: rtse mo rnam bkod bde ba'i zhing : sum brgya drug cu'i gzhal yas nas: rdo rje ḍāk+ki yab yum rnams: (274)sum brgya drug cu gshegs su gsol: mgrin pa ro 'dus longs spyod zhing : bcu drug bkod pa'i gzhal yas nas: rin chen ḍāk+ki yab yum rnams: bcu drug ma lus gshegs su gsol: dran pa rnam bkod chos kyi zhing : sum cu rtsa gnyis gzhal yas nas: pad+ma ḍāk+ki yab yum rnams: drug cu rtsa bzhi gshegs su gsol: myong byed rnam par bkod pa'i zhing : nyi shu rtsa brgyad gzhal yas nas: las kyi ḍāk+ki yab yum ni: nyi shu rtsa brgyad gshegs su gsol: rtsa khams rang bzhin gnas pa'i zhing : bkod pa lus kyi gzhal yas nas: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bye ba stong : ma lus 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol: de dag kun gyi bka' 'khor na: phyogs skyong zhing skyong glu chen brgyad: stong gsum 'jig rten (275)khams dag na: gnas bzhugs rigs bsdus ma sring tshogs: longs spyod tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: ces dbyangs rnga snyan pos spyan drangs so: bzhi pa mchod cing bstan pa ni: hūm̐: dus gsum bde gshegs yi dam lha: dngos grub stsol ba'i dus la babs: tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes su gsol: rta mgrin yab yum gtso 'khor bcas: dngos grub 'byung ba'i dus la bab: tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes su gsol: mkha' 'gro sde lnga yab yum gtso 'khor bcas: dngos grub 'byung ba'i dus la bab: tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes su gsol: de sogs ḍāk+ki'i rigs gyur ma lus kun: dngos grub stsol ba'i dus la bab: tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes su gsol: dam tshig sha za 'jig rten mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: dngos grub 'byung ba'i dus la bab: tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes su gsol: chos skyong pho rgyud mo rgyud thams cad kyang :

dngos grub stsol ba'i dus (276)la bab: tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes su gsol: 'jig rten snang srid lha 'dre thams cad kyang : dngos grub stsol ba'i dus la bab: tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes su gsaul: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥm ha ni sa ra tsa hrīḥya ma ha kā a ma ma rak+mo du tri phu tri ya ma ra tsa ga ṇa tsakra pu tsa khā hi: ma hā tsirta khā hi: ma hā rak+ta khā hi: ma hā go ro tsa na khā hi: ma hā ba su khā hi: ma hā keṃ ni ri ti khā hi: ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi: ces lan bdun gyis 'bul lo: lnga pa tshogs kyis bskang ba ni: hūm̐: bskang ngo bskal pa'i thugs dam bskang : tshogs gtor mchod pas thugs dam bskang : dus gsum bla ma yi dam yang : zhal zas tshogs gtor mchod pas thugs dam bskang : lta spyod ting nge 'jin gyis thugs dam bskang : bdud rtsi rak+ta ja gad thugs dam (277)bskang : glu gar sgrub pa dam tshig thugs dam bskang : mthun pa'i rdzas kyis thugs dam bskang gyur cig: dpal chen khro rgyal rta mgrin yang : zhal zas tshogs gtor mchod pas thugs dam bskang : lta spyod ting nge 'jin gyis thugs dam bskang : bdud rtsi rak+ta ja gad thugs dam bskang : gla gar sgrub pa dam tshig thugs dam bskang : mthun pa'i rdzas kyi thugs dam bskang gyur cig: ḍāk+ki sde lnga yab yum 'khor bcas kyang : zhal zas tshogs gtor mchod pas thugs dam bskang : lta spyod ting nge 'jin gyis thugs dam bskang : bdud rtsi rak+ta ja gad thugs dam bskang : glu gar sgrub pa dam tshig thugs dam bskang : mthun pa'i rdzas kyis thugs dam bskang gyur cig: snang srid mkha' 'gro ma lus thams cad kyang : zhal (278)zas tshogs gtor mchod pas thugs dam bskang : lta spyod ting nge 'jin gyis thugs dam bskang : bdud rtsi rak+ta ja gad thugad dam bskang : glu gar sgrub pa dam tshig thugs dam bskang : mthun pa'i rdzas kyis thugs dam bskang gyur cig: snang srid lha 'dre ma lus 'khor bcas kyang :

zhal zas tshogs gtor mchod pas thugs dam bskang : lta spyod ting nge 'jin gyis thugs dam bskang : bdud rtsi rak+ta ja gad thugs dam bskang : glu gar sgrub pa dam tshig thugs dam bskang : mthun pa'i rdzas gyis thugs dam bskang gyur cig: ces bskang ngo : drug pa tshogs kyi bshags pa bya ba ni: gang gi bshags pa la: zhes yig chung 'dug kyang gsang sgrub gyi tshogs mchod kyi yig chung 'dir shag shor ba 'dra bas 'og nas 'byung ba'i bshags pa la zhes pa 'thad do mchan/ de nas bshags pa bya ba ni: hūm̐: dus gsum (279)bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: dpang gyu rdo rje dam can dgongs su gsaul: ye shes mkha' 'gro yab yum chos kyi sku: ye nas bdag dang dbye ba med pa la: ma rig dbang gis snang stong gnyis su 'thas: gnyis 'jin the tshom log lta ci bgyis pa: rang mdangs rig pa'i klong du mthol lo bshags: bzod par bzhes nas tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: rdo rje ḍāk+ki yab yum gtso 'khor bcas: sum brgya drug cu gsan cing dgongs su gsol: lta ba ma rtogs log dang rtogs rdzus btab: kha lta bdud dbang song dang log par bltas: yid dpyod mtha' bral klong du mthol lo bshags: bzod par bzhes nas tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: rin chen mkha' 'gro yab yum gtso 'khor bcas: yab yum (280)bcu drug gsan cing dgongs su gsol: mnyam bzhag ting 'jin don las g.yel gyur te: ma gsal ma rig bskyed rdzogs don ma bsgoms: gsal stong bde chen ngang du mthol lo bshags: bzod par bzhes nas tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: pad+ma ḍāk+ki yab yum gtso 'khor bcas: drug cu rtsa bzhi gsan cing dgongs su gsol: dus la ma bab spyod pa chos dang 'gal: ma rig dbang gis nyes par ci spyad pa: dmigs med shar grol klong du mthol lo bshags: bzod par bzhes nas tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: sangs rgya mkha' 'gro yab yum gtso 'khor bcas:

sum cu rtsa gnyis gsan cing dgongs su gsol: yang dag don gyi gnas lugs ma shes te: the tshom dbang gis 'bras bu'i don dang 'gal: re dogs mtha' bral klong du mthol (281)lo bshags: bzod par bzhes nas tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: las kyi mkha' 'gro yab yum gtso 'akor bcas: nyi shu rtsa brgyad gsan cing dgongs su gsol: phrin las rnam bzhi'i srung sdom don ma shes: bya ba kun nas log pa ci bgyis pa: kun mkhyen gsal ba'i klong du mthol lo bshags: bzod par bzhes nas tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: ko ri ma brgyad seng ha phra men brgyad: sgo ma bzhi dang dbang phyug nyi shu brgyad: loṅka brgyad dang ma bdun sring mo bzhi: ging chen bco brgyad pho nya drug cu bzhi: bstan ma lo ka las la grub pa sogs: kun gyi thugs dang 'gal gyur ci mchis pa: phyi nang gsang ba bdud rtsi tshogs gtor dang : lta sgom spyod pa ting 'jin thugs dam bskang : thugs dam gnyan skang nyams chags (282)dngos grub zhu: zhes dang : bdag cag ma rig lus dang ngag sems kyis: bag med tshul gyis dam las 'gal gyur pa: zhal zas tshogs gtor mchod pas so sor bshags: bdag gis bcol ba'i phrin las sgrub tu gsol:

ces yig brgya bzla'o: zhes btags la bshags pa bya'o: bdun pa ling ga bsgral ba ni: tshogs phud cha tha ma la dgra bgegs kyi ling ka bcas la lcags kyu'i phyag rgyas: a mu ka hri aṃ ku sha jaḥ zhes pas yul gang yin gyi rnam par shes pa bkug la: badz+ra pā sha hūm̐: zhes zhags pa'i phyag rgyas bcings: badz+ra s+pho ṭa bam̐: zhes pas lcags sgrog gi phyag rgyas bsdom: badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe hoḥ zhes dril bu'i phyag rgyas gzugs dang rnam par shes pa dbyer med du 'gre'o: de nas ngag tu: hrīḥm ha ri ni sa ra tsa hri ces brjod pas bdag rta mgrin yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa stod gzhung dang mthun pa: smad phur pa lcags sol mal nas bton pa lta bur bsam la 'di skad do: hūm̐: nga ni rta (283)mgrin yab yum ste: 'khor du mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis bskor: kun kyang mi bzad 'jigs pa'i gzugs: dmar nag me yi mtshon cha 'phro: khro bo'i gzugs kyi nam mkha' gang : stod ni zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: gnam lcags ngar ma'i phur pa 'dril: smad ni ye shes phur pa ste: nam mkha'i mthong nas 'dril zhing 'debs: drag por bsgrub pa'i phur pa ste: btab na lha yang brlag par 'gyur: gnod byed dgra bgegs smos ci dgos: gzir ba tsam gyis rdul du rlog: hūm̐: nga ni dpal chen rta mgrin rgyal: khro rgyal yab yum 'khor bcas rnams: phyag gnyis gnam lcags phur pa 'dril: rgya mdud rtse nas 'brug stong ldir: chang zung mtshams nas glog stong 'khyugs: chu srin kha nas tsha tsha 'phro: rtse mo mtshon (284)cha 'od zer 'gyed: dgra bgegs steng du mā ra ya: a mu ka u tsa ta ya hūm̐ phaṭa: ces chu srin rnam grol gyis phyag rgyas blang ngo : de nas brgyad pa bsgral ba dngos la drug las: dang po lha dang dbye ba ni: bh+yoḥ rna nyan chen po phra ma mkhan: dngos grub 'phrog pa'i dgra dang bgegs: gdug cing sdang sems ldan pa rnams: 'go ba'i lha dang bral bar gyis: che ge drag tu ma ra ya phaṭa:

gnyis pa gzugs la dbab pa ni: bh+yoḥ las mkhan chen mo'i dus la bab: dngos grub 'phrog pa'i dgra dang bgegs: gdug cing sdang sems ldan pa rnams: rnam shes srog la rnam par phob: a mu ka a be sha ya hūm̐ phaṭa: gsum pa byad du gzhugs pa ni: bh+yoḥ 'chang byed chen mo'i dus la bab: dngos grub 'phrog pa'i dgra dang bgegs: gdug cing sdang sems ldan pa rnams: zung zhig sdoms shig (285)rnam par chings: a mu ka shrī kri a na ya hūm̐ phaṭa: bzhi pa smyo ru 'jug pa ni: bh+yoḥ smyo byed chen po'i dus la bab: dngos grub 'phrog pa'i dgra dang bgegs: gdug cing sdang sems ldan pa rnams: lus ngag yid gsum myos par gyis: a mu ka dz+wa la sa ma ya hūm̐ phaṭa: lnga pa gtun du brdung ba ni: bh+yoḥ rdung byed chen mo'i dus la bab: dngos grub 'phrog pa'i dgra dang bgegs: gdug cing sdang sems ldan pa rnams: lus ngag rdul phran bzhin du rdungs: a mu ka bhin dha ya hūm̐ phaṭa: drug pa zha bye ba ni: bh+yoḥ gdug pa sgrol mkhas ḍāk+ki yum gyi tshogs: dgra bgegs sha ni zan bas zhim: dgra bgegs khrag ni chang bas zhim: dgra bgegs rus pa mar bas bzhun: dug pa mchod pa 'bul (286)ba'i phyir: ma lus 'khor bcas zhal phyes shig: de nas dgungs zhal du btab pa ni: bh+yoḥ dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i dug gsum mchod pa 'di: dpal chen rta mgrin yab yum zhal du bstab: gsol cig rol cig kha raṃ khā hi: mkha' 'gro sde bzhi yab yum zhal du bstab: gsol cig rol cig kha raṃ khā hi: 'khor gyi mkha' 'gro las mkhan zhal du bstab: gsol cig rol cig kha raṃ khā hi: chos skyong srung ma sde brgyad zhal du bstab: gsol cig rol cig kha raṃ khā hi: bsgral ba'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la: sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub zhu: rkyen ngan bar chad bzlog tu gsol: ma hā ru tra u tsa ta khā hi: ma hā maṃ sa khā hi: rak+ta khā hi: tsirta khā hi: go ro tsa na khā hi:

keṃ ni ri ti khā hi: ba su ta khā hi: ma hā pañtsa khā hi: a mṛ ta (287)khā hi: bha ling ta khā hi: zhes lan bdun gyis 'bul lo: bcu pa tshogs la rol zhing lhag ma'i cho ga bya'o: zhes pa'i 'og nas 'thung ba'i lhag ma'i cho ga nin de nas lhag ma'i gtor ma 'di skad do: bh+yoḥ las kyi mkha' 'gro mi srun ma: shin tu 'jigs pa'i keng rus gzugs: yan lag rus pa'i 'khor los brgyan: snying khrag 'thung zhing skan sgra rdeb: rkang mgyogs brtul zhugs gdug rtsub can: dam tshig can gyi las mkhan mo: dam nyams ru tra'i srog gcod yin: lhag ma'i gtor ma 'di long la: dgra bgegs zhing bcu bsgral du gsol: drag po'i las mjod bstan pa srung : khyed kyi thugs dam dus la bab: bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mjod: bh+yoḥ 'jig rten mkha' 'gro rdzu 'phrul can: srin mo'i lus la lce spyang gdong : sbrul nag lce la spyan (288)mig ldog: kha brlang dug la nga ro 'brug: khros pas sme khrag ser chen 'bebs: mi lpags g.yang gzhi phyogs bcur rdeb: rgyu zhags 'dom dgu dgra la chings: ba spru mtshon cha me ltar 'bar: bye ba dung phyur 'khor dang bcas: dam tshig can gyi las mkhan mo: dam nyams ru tra'i srog gcod ma: lhag ma'i gtor ma 'di long la : dgra bgegs zhing bcu bsgral du gsol: drag po'i las mjod bstan pa srungs: khyod kyi thugs dam dus la bab: bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mjod: bh+yoḥ sha za mkha' 'gro yang sprul tshogs: yi dwags lus la dur bya'i gdong : dur khrod sked la thod pas brgyan: lus las khrag rul chu ser 'bebs: sme sngags tshig la dud mo'i dbyangs: phyi na 'dre 'tshub sprin ltar ldir: ro langs rkang la dur khrod lus: phung (289)'dre'i lag pa gza' srin mig: dam tshig can gyi las mkhan mo: dam nyams ru tra'i srog gcod pa: lhag ma'i gtor ma 'di long la: dgra bgegs zhing bcu bsgral du gsol:

drag po'i las mjod bstan pa srungs: khyed kyi thugs dam dus la bab: bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mjod: bh+yoḥ gzhan yang mkha' 'gro pho nya'i tshogs: la la myur mgyogs bstan pa srung : bu chung lus la bya rog mgo: dbyug gu'i dbyangs la thi bya'i tshig: ri gsum 'grim zhing lung gsum bskor: chu la zhon nas grib po 'grim: lce spyang pho nya dri ro snom: da li'i tha ma bskor zhing nyul: las byed mi sdug 'khor dang bcas: dam tshig can gyi las mkhan yin: dam nyams ru tra'i srog gcod ma: lhag ma'i gtor ma (290)'di longs la: dgra bgegs zhing bcu bsgral du gsol: drag po'i las mjod bstan pa srung : khyed kyi thugs dam dus la bab: bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mjod: ces lhag gtor gtong ngo : de nas phyi nang gi mkha' 'gro ma la phrin las bskul ba ni: bh+yoḥ chos dbyings 'gyur med bde chen klong : sna tshogs sprul pa 'gro ba'i zhing : stong gsal longs spyod ḍāk+ki ma: lcang lo dung khang gzhal yas na: sum brgya drug cu'i dkyil 'khor ni: 'dab bzhi chos 'byung dkar gsal dbus: thabs shes pad+ma nyi zlal la: rdo rje mkha' 'gro yab yum ni: gtso 'khor sum brgya drug cu ste: sku mdog dkar gsal me long sku: zhe sdang 'joms phyir thod khrag dkrugs: spyan gsum sdang mig dgra la lta: zhal nas drag sngags bgegs la 'bod: shangs nas nad kyi 'tshub ma 'thor: (291)tshogs gtor mchod pa 'di gsol la: dgra bgegs zhing bcu bsgral du gsol: khyed kyi thugs dam dus la bab: drag po'i phrin las myur du mjod: sngags kyi bstan pa bsrung du gsol: bh+yoḥ mgrin pa longs spyod gzhal yas na: bcu drug bkod pa'i dkyil 'khor ni: 'dab bzhi chos 'byung sair gsal dbus: thabs shes pad+ma nyi zla la: rin chen yab yum mkha' 'gro ni: gtso 'khor brgyad gnyis bcu drug ste: sku mdog ser gsal mnyam nyid sku: nga rgya 'joms phyir thod khrag dkrugs:

spyan gsum sdang mig dgra la lta: zhal nas drag sngags bgegs la 'bod: shangs nas nad kyi 'tshub ma 'thor: tshogs gtor mchod pa 'di gsol la: dgra bgegs zhing bcu bsgral du gsol: khyed kyi thugs (292)dam dus la bab: drag po'i phrin las myur du mjod: sngags kyi bstan pa srung du gsol: bh+yo: dran pa rnams bkod pa gzhal yas na: sum cu rtsa gnyis dkyil 'khor ni: 'dab bzhi chos 'byung mthing gsal dbus: thabs shes pad+ma nyi zla la: sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro yab yum ni: gtso 'khor sum cu rtsa gnyis te: sku mdog mthing gsal chos dbyings sku: gti mug 'joms phyir thod khrag dkrugs: spyan gsum sdang mig dgra la lta: zhal nas drag sngags bgegs la 'bod: shangs nas nad kyi 'tshub ma 'thor: tshogs gtor mchod pa 'di gsol la: dgra bgegs zhing bcu bsgral du gsaul: khyed kyi thugs dam dus la bab: drag po'i phrin las myur du mjod: sngags kyi bstan pa srung du gsol: bh+yoḥ skyed byed sprul pa'i gzhal yas na: drug (293)cu rtsa bzhi'i dkyil 'khor ni: 'dab bzhi chos 'byung dmar gsal dbus: thabs shes pad+ma nyi zla la: pad+ma ḍāk+ki yab yum ni: gtso 'khor drug cu rtsa bzhi ste: sku mdog dmar gsal sor rtogs sku: 'dod chags 'joms phyir thod khrag dkrugs: spyan gsum sdang mig dgra la lta: zhal nas drag sngags bgegs la 'bod: shangs nas nad kyi 'tshub ma 'thor: tshogs gtor mchod pa 'di gsol la: dgra bgegs zhing bcu bsgral du gsol: khyed kyi thugs dam dus la bab: drag po'i phrin las myur du mjod: sngags kyi bstan pa srung du gsol: bh+yoḥ myong byed bde chen gzhal yas nas: nyi shu rtsa brgyad dkyil 'khor ni: 'dab bzhi chos 'byung ljang gsal dbus: thabs shes pad+ma nyi zla la: las kyi ḍāk+ki yab yum ni: (294)gtso 'khor nyi shu rtsa brgyad de: sku mdog ljang gsal bya grub sku: phrag dog 'joms phyir thod khrag dkrugs:

spyan gsum dgra la sdang mig ste: zhal nas drag sngags bgegs la 'bod: shangs nas nad kyi 'tshub ma 'thor: tshogs gtor mchod 'di gsol la: dgra bgegs zhing bcu bsgral du gsol: khyed kyi thugs dam dus la bab: drag po'i phrin las myur du mjod: sngags kyi bstan pa bsrung du gsol: de ni nang rig pa'i lha lnga brgyad dang bdun cu rtsa gnyis phrin las la bskul ba yin no: da ni yab yum sku'i dkyil 'khor gyi mkha' 'gro 'bum tshogs nyi shu bskul ba ni: bh+yoḥ dur khrod rab 'jigs nags ma'i gling : rtsu 'gyur lcang lo can gyi gnas: rus dang rnag khrag mtshon cha'i tshal: sha zan bya spyang mang po'i gnas: khro bcu rgyu bar mi nus shing : phyag na rdo rje skyi (295)g.ya'i gnas: de lta bu yi gnas mchog na: dus gsum sangs rgyas bskyed pa'i yum: rdo rje phag mo yab yum bzhugs: yab yum 'khrigs pa'i spyi gtsug na: phag zhal rta gdong ljang nag las: dgra la khrag nad gtong ba'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: yab yum khro zhal gnyis med sbyor ba las: bde gshegs las la bskul ba'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: yab yum dbu la thod lngas brgyan pa las: rigs lngas 'gro don mjad pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: dam rdzas bdud rtsi 'bar ba 'di gsaul la: do nub sdang ba'i dgra la bh+yo: do nub gnod pa'i bgegs la bh+yo: yab yum dbu yi thor gtsug 'khyil pa las: bde gshegs dgongs pa bskul ba'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: yab yum phyag g.yas gri gug bsnams pa las: srog gcod bdud len byed pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: (296)g.yon gnyis bhan+dha khrag can bsnams pa las: khrag nad gzer thabs gtong ba'i mkha' gro 'bum: dam rdzas bdud rtsi 'bar ba 'di gso la: do nub sdang ba'i dgra la bh+yo: do nub gnod pa'i bgegs la bh+yo: kha ṭ+wām̐ rtse gsum mchan khung bcug pa las: khams gsum dbang du sdud pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: de la rdo rje rtse lngas brgyan pa las: don dam stong nyid rtogs pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum:

thod pa sum brtsegs rab tu brgyan pa las: srid gsum zil gyi gnon pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: dam rdzas bdud rtsi 'bar ba 'di gsol la: do nub sdang ba'i dgra la bh+yo: do nub gnod pa'i bgegs la bh+yo: dar gyi phur lce rab tu mjes pa las: bdud kyi dmag dpung 'joms pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: gser gyi dril bu rnga dung 'phyang ba las: snyan brgyud gdams pa 'jin pa'i (297)mkha' 'gro 'bum: yu ba dkar po drang zhing 'dril ba las: lha min g.yul ngo bzlog pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: dam rdzas bdud rtsi 'bar ba 'di gso la: do nub sdang ba'i dgra la bh+yo: do nub gnod pa'i bgegs la bh+yo: mi mgo lnga bcu'i do shal 'phyang ba las: 'du byed lnga bcu zad pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: rus pa'i rgyan drug sku la gsol ba 'debs: phar phyin 'gro don mjad pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: yab yum gnyis med 'khril bar sbyor ba las: rtog med bde chen rtog pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: dam rdzas bdud rtsi 'bar ba 'di gsol la: do nub sdang ba'i dgra la bh+yo: do nub gnod pa'i bgegs la bh+yo: gcer bu skra grol 'gying zhing brjid pa las: stong nyid ye shes rtogs pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: zhabs bzhi brkyang bskum rtse gcig (298)bzhags pa las: pha rol pa bcu gnon pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: dam rdzas bdud rtsi 'bar ba 'di gsol la: do nub sdang ba'i dgra la bh+yo: do nub gnod pa'i bgegs la bh+yo: ro yi gdan la rab tu bzhugs pa las: dur khrod sha la rol pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs pa las: thabs shes mthar phyin mun sel mkha' 'gro 'bum: sku yi rgyan rnams rab tu rdzogs pa las: che btsan 'gran zla bral ba'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: bskal pa'i me ri rab tu 'khrugs pa las: ma rig rog mtha' sreg pa'i mkha' gro 'bum: 'khor du ḍāk+ki mang pos bskor ba las: sna tshogs phrin las mjad pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: dam rdzas bdud rtsi 'bar ba 'di gsaul la:

do nub sdang ba'i dgra la bh+yo: do nub gnod pa'i (299)bgegs la bh+yo: bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mjod: ces sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi mkha' 'gro 'bum tshogs nyi shu bskul ba'o: 'di gnyan pas tshogs pa dang gtor ma'i dus min par bya ba'i nyan no: bde nas sna tshogs kyi ḍāk+ki bskul ba ni: bh+yoḥ mkha' dbyings bde ba chen po nas: ye shes ḍāk+ki bye ba 'um: rdo rje mkha' 'gro bdud 'dul ma: rin chen mkha' 'gro sa ma yi: pad+ma mkha' 'gro bde chen ma: las kyi mkha' 'gro phrin las bdag: kun kyang cha lugs 'di 'dra ste: sku dmog gcig tu ma nges te: dkar ser dmar ljang mthing mun dmog: sngo skya khra mo thal ba'i mdog: phyag mtshan gcig tu ma nges te: gri gug kha ṭam̐ thod pa 'jin: rnga chung rtog 'joms mtshon cha thogs: rol mo'i sgra dang rgyan cha thogs: bdud rtsi (300)mchod pa rol zhing stob: dur khrod rgyan la mjes pa'i gzugs: sked pa dril bu g.yer khas brgyan: dar dpyangs rus pa'i rgyan drug gsol: snyan pa'i sgra sgrog si li li: dbu rgyan dar gyi cod pan can: rlung gi bskyod cing pu ru ru: rkang pa rdo rje'i sgeg 'gros can: mkha' la thogs med bun nu nu: lag pa gser gyi gdu bu can: sna tshogs gar byed khugs se khyug: phrin las gcig tu ma nges te: rnam bzhi sna tshogs nyid mjad ma: rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di gsol la: 'dod pa'i phrin las myur du sgrubs:

de nas yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i zhing skyes ma bskul ba ni: bh+yoḥ gnas mchog nyi shu rtsa bzhi na: mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo nyi su bzhi: mkha' 'gro bye ba 'khor dang bcas: gtso mo mi mngon dbyings na bzhugs: 'khor gyi (301)mkha' 'gro bye ba 'dum: kun kyang mi bzad 'di 'dra ste: ma la bud med rgan mo la: ro shun rnying ba'i na bza' gsol: snum dang khrag gi thig les brgyan: zhal nas ha ni hūm̐ phaṭa sgrogs: rkang pa 'khor lo bzhi yi 'gros: lag pa ber gangs la btsug: sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la: rkyen bzlog dgra thul dngos grub stsol: bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mjod: la la bud med gzhon nu la: bcu drug gzugs mjes long tsho rgyas: sna tshogs rgyan ldan yid 'ong ma: rigs spyod kha dog so so la: khro gnyer mjes 'jub ldan pa'i gzugs: phrin las rnams la bskul ma 'debs: kun kyang cha lugs 'di 'dra ste: mjes pa'i zhal 'jum gzi mdangs can: gzhon nu'i sku la 'gying bag ldan: dbu la rin chen (302)cod pan 'phur: rang gi dpa' bo'i zhabs la'adud: rked pa g.yer kha'i dra ba can: sil sil sgra sgrog sku la sbyor: lag pa gnyen lcugs gdu bu can: rang gi dpa' bo'i mgul nas 'khyud: ser mo gser gyi sor gdub can: brda dang brda yi lan la mkhas: zhal ni pad+ma'i dug po can: 'jum pa'i mdangs kyi snyan par smra: skad snyan tshangs pa rdo rje'i gsung : snyan pa'i glu len yid 'phrog ma: rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: rkyen bzlog dgra thul dngos grub rtsol: bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mjodaḥ la la bud med tha mal gzugs: lo ka'i spyod pa sna tshogs byed: khyed ni mi spyod gang yang med: la la sgyur byed chos mkhan mo: log par lta ba'i rnam rtog sgyur: la la myos byed chang 'tshong ma: log lta'i shes pa myos par (303)gyis: la la sbyor byed smad 'tshong ma: thabs dang shes rab sbyor ba gyis: la la dag byed khrus mkhan ma:

bag chags dri ma dag par gyis: la la gsod byed shan pa mo: rtog pa skye med dbyings su sod: la la dka' thub bram ze mo: 'khor ba'i skyon dang bral bar gyis: la la len byed chom rkun mo: gzhan sems rang dbang med par gyis: de la sogs te mtha' yas pa: ri rab lho yi 'jam gling na: yul gru nyi shu rtsa bzhi ni: sems can don la bzhugs pa rnams: mos pa du ma'i sems can la: spyod pa sna tshogs thabs kyis 'dul: rak+ta'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi: mi mthun phyogs kyi nyes pa zlog: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub (304)zhu: bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mjod: ces bskul lo: de nas zor lam dbye ba gzhan dang mthun no: zor 'phen pa ni: bh+yoḥ da ni rnal 'byor sngags 'chang bdag: dgra bgegs steng du zor cig 'phen: dgra bgegs gdug pa zor kha longs: dregs pa rta mgrin yab yum ste: mkha' 'gro'i dmag dpung sde brgyad tshogs: kun kyang drag po'i zor thogs la: dgra bgegs steng du zor kha ya: zor mā ra ya zor yā: zhes 'phang ngo : de nas gtor ma skyong ba ni: bh+yoḥ dpal chen yab yum bka' nyan ma: shar nas gshegs pa'i mkha' 'gro bdun: drug ni ye shes dbyings na bzhugs: gcig ni thabs kyi sgo ma mjad: rdo rje rigs kyi ḍāk+ki bdun: dam rdzas gtor ma 'di bzhes la: khyod kyi zhi ba'i phrin las mjod: de bzhin du: (305)lho nas gshegs pa'i mkha' 'gro bdun: drug ni ye shes dbyings nas bzhugs: gcig ni thabs kyi sgo ma mjad: rin chen rigs kyi ḍāk+ki bdun: dam rdzas gtor ma 'di bzhes la: khyed kyi rgyas pa'i phrin las mjod: nub nas gshegs pa'i mkha' 'gro bdun: drug ni ye shes dbyings na bzhugs: gcig ni thabs kyi sgo ma mjad: pad+ma rigs kyi ḍāk+ki bdun: dam rdzas gtor ma 'di bzhes la: khyod kyi dbang gi phrin las mjod: byang nas gshegs pa'i mkha' 'gro bdun:

drug ni ye shes dbyings na bzhugs: gcig ni thabs kyi sgo ma mjad: las kyi rigs kyi ḍāk+ki bdun: dam rdzas gtor ma 'di bzhes la: khyod kyi drag po'i phrin las mjod: dpal chen yab yum bka' sdod bka' nyan tshogs: dbang phyug nyer brgyad (306)ḍāk+ki sum cu gnyis: ging chen bco brgyad laṅka dur khrod bdag: ma bdun sring bzhi 'bar ma lnga bcu brgyad: drug cu bzhi dang 'bum khrag mkha' 'gro bcas: bshes gnyen klong rdzogs pad+ma'i spyan snga ru: khas blangs dam bcas bka' yi gtor ma long : zhi rgyas dbang drag dgug bskrad mnan gzir sogs: bcol ba'i phrin las ma lus grub par mjod: ces brtan ma skyong ngo : de nas rta bro brdung ba ni: gtor gzhong 'og tu ling ga bcug la: bh+yoḥ dmar nag gru gsum me yi dkyil 'khor nas: 'jigs byed khro rgyal rta mgrin khros pa'i sku: gnyis med 'khril sbyor rdo rje phag mo yum: thod sbrul rgyan ldan g.yas gnyis gri gug bsnams: g.yon gnyis thod khrag tri shul rus pas brgyan: rta mgo phag zhal ngur 'tsher phyogs bcur sgrogs: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i (307)tshogs rnams dam la 'dus: sdug bsngal nad kyi tshom bu la: rol pa'i rta bro chems se chem: rta bro 'khor gcig dang po la: bdud 'dul 'joms pa chen po'i bro: nga rgyal 'joms pa'i mkha' 'gro ma: zhing bcu'i tshogs la da rdungs shig: rta bro 'khor gcig bar ma la: srin po sha za longs spyod bro: zhe sdang 'joms pa'i mkha' 'gro ma: 'byung po'i tshogs la da rdungs shig: rta bro 'khor gcig tha ma la: khams gsum khrag 'thung nad kyi bro: gti mug 'joms pa'i mkha' 'gro ma: 'khor ba'i gcong nad skran la rdungs: rdul du rlog cig mkha' 'gro ma: rgya mtsho'i gting sba ri rab mnan: 'khor skyon chu srin kha ru bor: oṃ āḥhūm̐ s+t+waṃ bha ya nan: ces rta bro brdungs ngo : de nas bkra shis brjod pa ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐:

(308)ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rjes mngon du gyur: chos dbyings rnam dag klong la mnga' brnyes pa'i: bla ma yi dam rnams kyi bkra shis gang legs pa: bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog: dkar mo zhi mjad gar sgyur sgeg pa mo: me long ye shes rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma: 'gro ba'i lus la dbang sgyur mkha' 'gro 'bum: bkra shis dam pa dengs kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog: ser mo rgyas mjad gar sgyur sgeg pa mo: mnyam nyid ye shes rin chen mkha' 'gro ma: 'gro ba'i yon tan dbang bsgyur gter gyi ḍāk+ki 'bum: bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog: dmar mo dbang mjad gar sgyur sgeg pa mo: sor rtogs ye shes pad+ma mkha' 'gro ma: 'gro ba'i ngag la dbang sgyur gsung gi mkha' 'gro 'bum: bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog: mthing kha (309)chod mjadza gar sgyur sgeg pa mo: chos dbyings ye shes sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma: 'gro ba'i yid la dbang sgyur thugs kyi mkha' 'gro 'bum: bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog: ljang gu las mjad gar sgyur sgeg pa mo: nan tan ye shes las kyi mkha' 'gro ma: 'gro ba'i las la dbang sgyur mkha' 'gro 'bum: bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog: sna tshogs mkha' 'gro dur khrod brgyad kyi bdag: tshogs brgyad dbang sgyur 'jig rten mkha' 'gro ma: bka' srung mkha' 'gro rnams kyi bkra shis gang lags pa: bkra shis dam pa deng kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog: ces bkra shis brjod: lha gshegs bsngo smon lam bya: khang gi dus yin na sbyin sreg bya: dal bsdu: yig brgya lhag chad bskang : bsod nams tshogs chen rdzogs pa dang : ma srings las la bskul (310) ba yi: las byang tshogs mchod rtsar phreng 'di: ye shes mtsho rgyal khyod la gtad: las can gcig dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: rdzogs so: : gter ston pad+ma las 'brel rtsal gyis gter ma'o/

dge'o/ maṅga lam/ 'di la las byang tshogs mchod gnyis legs par bsdeb ste 'jug bde bar bgyid pa so kun mkhyen bla mas gnang ba thob pa'i rnal 'byor pa 'od gsal rin chen snying po las 'brel rtsal gyis bgyis so/// /
